SOUND MODE PLEASE SET THIS ITEM TO STEREO FOR NORMAL OPERATIONS. SETTING TO "MONAURAL" WILL MAKE YOUR SOUND OUTPUT MONAURAL. (WHEN USING NAOMI CONVERTER KIT, PLEASE REFER TO PAGE 3.) DEMO SOUND HALF IF SET TO "ON", THE ATTRACT MODE DEMO SOUND PLAYS AT HALF VOLUME. (TO ENABLE THIS SETTING, "ADVERTISE SOUND" MUST SET "ON". PLEASE REFFER TO "NAOMI SYSTEM MENU" FOR DETAIL.) CONTINUE TURNS ON AND OFF THE CONTINUE FEATURE. DIFFICULTY SETS THE GAME'S DIFFICULTY LEVEL. THERE ARE 8 LEVELS IN TOTAL. AS THE NUMBER INCREASES. THE GAME GETS MORE DIFFICULT. DAMAGE LEVEL SETS THE ATTACK POWER. THERE ARE 4 LEVELS IN TOTAL. AS THE NUMBER INCREASES, THE ATTACK POWER INCREASES. (THUS THE AVERAGE PLAY TIME GETS SHORTER.) TIMER SPEED SETS THE TIMER SPEED. THERE ARE 4 LEVELS IN TOTAL. AS THE NUMBER INCREASES, THE TIME ELAPSES QUICKER. GAME SPEED SETS THE GAME SPEED. THE FOLLOWING ARE AVAILABLE: “NORMAL": REGULAR SETTING. “TURBO": QUICKER GAME PLAY. “FREE SELECT": ALLOWS THE PLAYER TO SELECT "NORMAL" OR "TURBO". EVENT USE THIS FUNCTION FOR EVENTS/TOURNAMENTS. IF SET TO ON, ONLY | CREDIT IS REQUIRED FOR 2 PLAYERS "VS." GAME. HOWEVER, THE GAME WILL BE OVER FOR BOTH PLAYERS REGARDLESS OF THE GAME RESULT. PLEASE SET THIS TO OFF FOR STANDARD OPERATIONS.
